name: 52301-decode1k-nemotron3super120b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, the whole of one a3 node, NVLink4 within the node.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, sequence parallelism off. Eight ranks, one node, ~31 GB of weights per rank.
architecture: hybrid NemotronH decoder in BF16: 88 layers over hidden 4096 and vocab 131072 -- 40 mamba2 mixers, 40 mixture-of-experts layers and 8 attention layers; ~123.6 B parameters, ~247 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, bounded at 128 requests / 3600 s safety, 5% warmup and 5% cooldown, seed static 52301.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompt exactly 1000 tokens and output exactly 1000 (min = max on both), `ignore_eos`, `request_format: plain` on the completions path, temperature 0.0. Prompts are Faker-generated synthetic English, unique per request.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a 120-billion-parameter model, one user at a time streaming thousand-token replies across eight GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Source checkout of d4c24e6f5d1864bc81ad0769097e00b9042178ca
# (`git describe --tags --match 'v[0-9]*'` = v0.27.2rc0-80-gd4c24e6f5d), on 8x H100 80GB HBM3.

model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-BF16

tensor-parallel-size: 8

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# 1000 in + 1000 out = 2000 tokens per request; 2200 clears it with room. It also bounds the KV
# and recurrent-state pools.
max-model-len: 2200

# The scheduler's admission width. It sizes the recurrent-state pool; at a single stream it is
# never the binding constraint.
max-num-seqs: 128

attention-backend: FLASHINFER

enable-prefix-caching: true

mamba-cache-mode: align

enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

# The checkpoint's config.json carries an `auto_map`; this engine has an in-tree NemotronH class,
# so the remote modules are not what executes, but the flag is required to load the config.
trust-remote-code: true
